name: Five Nights at PP World Official: Remastered
summary: Welcome to the PP World Dungeon, a place where everyone here is treated like PP. You have an important job to do, as you are the night watchman. There are six teen employees from the dungeon when it was open, they are zombies back from the dead. You must use the cameras, doors and lights to track the locations of them.
